versos.hebraico: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
controles.kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
controles.livre: Deus, por que nos rejeitaste para sempre? Por que tua ira fumega contra as ovelhas do teu pasto?

versos.hebraico: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨׀ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה׀ שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
controles.kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
controles.livre: Lembra-te do teu povo,  que tu compraste desde a antiguidade; a tribo de tua herança, que resgataste; o monte Sião, em que habitaste.

versos.hebraico: הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כָּל־הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
controles.livre: Percorre  as ruínas duradouras, tudo que o inimigo destruiu no santuário.

versos.hebraico: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
controles.kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
controles.livre: Os teus inimigos rugiram no meio de tuas assembleias; puseram por sinais de vitória os símbolos deles.

versos.hebraico: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא לְמָ֑עְלָה בִּֽסֲבָךְ־עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
controles.kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
controles.livre: Eles eram como o que levantam machados contra os troncos das árvores.

versos.hebraico: ועת פִּתּוּחֶ֣יהָ יָּ֑חַד בְּכַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן׃

controles.web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
controles.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
controles.livre: E agora, com machados e martelos, quebraram todas as obras entalhadas.

versos.hebraico: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
controles.kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
controles.livre: Puseram fogo no teu santuário; profanaram levando ao chão o lugar onde o teu nome habita.

versos.hebraico: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
controles.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
controles.livre: Disseram em seus corações: Nós os destruiremos por completo; serão queimadas todas as assembleias de Deus na terra.

versos.hebraico: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין־ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא־אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד־מָֽה׃

controles.web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
controles.kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
controles.livre: Já não vemos os nossos sinais; já não há mais profeta; e ninguém entre nós sabe até quando será assim.

versos.hebraico: עַד־מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח׃

controles.web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
controles.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
controles.livre: Deus, até quando o adversário insultará? O inimigo blasfemará o teu nome para sempre?

versos.hebraico: לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִֽימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב חוקך כַלֵּֽה׃

controles.web: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!
controles.kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
controles.livre: Por que está afastada a tua mão direita? Tira-a do teu peito!

versos.hebraico: וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
controles.kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
controles.livre: Deus é o meu Rei desde a antiguidade; ele opera salvação no meio da terra.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
controles.kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
controles.livre: Tu dividiste o mar com a tua força; quebraste as cabeças dos monstros nas águas.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים׃

controles.web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
controles.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
controles.livre: Despedaçaste as cabeças do leviatã; e o deste como alimento ao povo do deserto.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן׃

controles.web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
controles.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
controles.livre: Tu dividiste a fonte e o ribeiro; tu secaste os rios perenes.

versos.hebraico: לְךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף־לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
controles.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
controles.livre: A ti pertence o dia, a noite também é tua; tu preparaste a luz e o sol.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּם׃

controles.web: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
controles.kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
controles.livre: Tu estabeleceste todos os limites da terra; tu formaste o verão e o inverno.

versos.hebraico: זְכָר־זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
controles.kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
controles.livre: Lembra-te disto: que o inimigo insultou ao SENHOR; e um povo tolo blasfemou o teu nome.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃

controles.web: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
controles.kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
controles.livre: Não entregues a vida da tua pombinha para os animais selvagens; não te esqueças para sempre da vida dos teus pobres.

versos.hebraico: הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס׃

controles.web: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
controles.kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
controles.livre: Olha para o teu pacto, porque os lugares escuros da terra estão cheios de habitações violentas.

versos.hebraico: אַל־יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
controles.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
controles.livre: Não permitas que o oprimido volte humilhado; que o aflito e o necessitado louvem o teu nome.

versos.hebraico: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי־נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
controles.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
controles.livre: Levanta-te, Deus; luta em favor de tua causa; lembra-te do insulto que o tolo faz a ti o dia todo.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

controles.web: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
controles.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
controles.livre: Não te esqueças da voz dos teus adversários; o barulho dos que se levantam contra ti sobe cada vez mais.
